title: English Premier League 2026-27: Here’s Where to Watch Soccer Matches Live Online for Free
summary: The 35th season of play starts Friday (Aug. 21) — watch matches online for free.
contentText:

Keep World Cup fever going with the 2026-27 English Premier League. Some of the best and brightest stars that captured the hearts of soccer fans during the World Cup — like Arsenal’s Bukayo Saka and Declan Rice, Manchester City’s Erling Haaland and Rodri, Tottenham’s Pedro Porro and others — take to the pitch for the 35th season of the league. Matches begin Friday (Aug. 21).

In the meantime, check out a complete schedule of matches here .

What Time Is the 202 6-27 English Premier League?

The Premier League 2026-27 season begins starting on Friday (Aug. 21) with Arsenal vs. Coventry City at 3 p.m. ET/noon PT. The season ends with the final on Sunday, May 30, 2027.

The matches broadcast on NBC and USA Network in English, Telemundo and Universo in Spanish, and livestream on Peacock .

Which Celebrities Are Making Appearances During the 202 6-27 English Premier League?

It’s likely there may be a number of celebrities and famous recording artists in attendance during Premier League matches in the United Kingdom. Be on the lookout for celebrity soccer fans who’ve been seen at matches in the past — like Dua Lipa, Adele, Fatboy Slim, Liam and Noel Gallagher, Sting, Tom Holland, Idris Elba, Prince Harry, Prince William, Lewis Hamilton, Timothée Chalamet, LeBron James and others.

How to Watch 2026-27 English Premier League Online for Free

In order to watch Premier League matches, you’ll need to have access to NBC and USA Network, as well as Telemundo and Universo. There are a few ways to watch online for free, including getting a subscription to DirecTV or Hulu + Live TV .

A subscription to Sling Blue , which comes with NBC and USA Network for Premier League matches, gets you access to more than 40 live TV channels. You can watch local networks such as ABC and FOX (all in select markets), while you can watch many cable networks too — priced at $54.99 per month. Please note: Pricing and channel availability vary depending on TV market. Learn more about Sling TV here .

Hulu + Live TV

Get 3-day free trial

Hulu + Live TV comes with Hulu, Disney+ and ESPN Unlimited at no additional cost.

If you don’t have a  Hulu + Live TV subscription, the streamer offers a  free trial  that’ll get you your first three days free to access NBC, USA Network and Telemundo, as well as more than 100 live TV channels. Once the free trial is over, you’ll be charged the regular subscription fee, which starts at $89.99 per month. For even more content, Hulu + Live TV bundles with Hulu, Disney+ and ESPN Unlimited at no extra cost to watch even more exclusive and original sporting events and programming.

Peacock

Get Peacock Premium

The official Premier League streamer in the United States.

There are two different plans offered on Peacock: The Premium Plan for $10.99 per month or the Premium Plus Plan for $16.99 per month, both feature matches on NBC and USA Network in English and Telemundo and Universo in Spanish.

If you’re looking to save, you can get 17% off when you do the annual plan for $109.99 per year or $169.99 per year, respectively. With the Premium Plan, it’s ad-supported and you’ll receive access to a wide range of movies, TV shows, originals, live sports from NBC Sports and live news from NBC News.

Peacock’s Premium Plus plan comes with everything in the Premium plan , no ads, your local NBC channel live and the ability to download and stream offline.

Alongside Premier League, you’ll have access to the entire Peacock library, including The Super Mario Galaxy Movie , Yellowstone , Five Nights At Freddy’s 2 , The Real Housewives of Beverly Hills , Poker Face , Saturday Night Live and others.

The streaming service also offers a number of music documentaries and specials, such as Toby Keith: An American Icon , Bowie: The Man Who Changed The World , Bob Dylan: The Folk Years , Stevie Nicks: Through The Looking Glass , Katy Perry: Main Square , Welcome To The A: 50 Years of Hip-Hop in Atlanta and more.

The 2026-27 English Premier League season matches are available to livestream on DirecTV and Peacock starting on Friday (Aug. 21).
